title: Identical Items and the Same HCPCS Code: Durable Medical Equipment Rentals Placement Limit
content:
**Edit statement.** Under Durable Medical Equipment Rentals a patient may have only one ordered, rented or owned placement per HCPCS code at a time; an order for a second identical item is payable only as a replacement under the replacement rules. Rental months of two placements are never added together toward one cap, and a replacement starts a new rental period. The patient has no ordered or in-rental placement with the same HCPCS code.

## What the edit reads on an incoming order

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Condition | The patient has no ordered or in-rental placement with the same HCPCS code. |
| When it applies | To an order for an item of durable medical equipment. |
| When it is assessed | On the records as they stand before the order is booked. |
| Authority | The company's placement records; the patient's own account of what they hold does not decide it. |
| Same object | A placement of the same patient with the same HCPCS code as the order. |
| Statuses that engage the condition | Ordered; in rental. |
| What is compared | A separate, existing placement record of that patient and code. |

## Consequences stated by the edit

1. **One per code.** At any time the patient has at most one ordered, rented or owned placement for a given HCPCS code.
2. **Second identical item.** An order for a second identical item is payable only as a replacement under the replacement rules.
3. **Caps are per placement.** The paid rental months of one placement and those of another are never added together toward one cap.
4. **Replacement period.** A replacement starts a new rental period of its own.

## Hypothetical cases

| Records before the order (hypothetical) | Incoming order | The condition |
|---|---|---|
| An in-rental placement coded E0601 for the patient | A new order coded E0601 for the same patient | Not met: an in-rental placement with the same code exists |
| An ordered, not yet delivered placement coded K0823 | A new order coded K0823 for the same patient | Not met: an ordered placement with the same code exists |
| An in-rental placement coded E0601 | A new order coded E0470 for the same patient | Not engaged by that placement: the codes differ |
| An in-rental placement coded E0601 held by another patient | A new order coded E0601 for this patient | Not engaged by that placement: it belongs to a different patient |

**Cap illustration (hypothetical).** If an earlier placement of a code had 8 paid rental months and a replacement placement of the same code now has 2, the replacement's count toward its cap is 2: the two placements' months are not added together, and the replacement counts from the start of its own rental period.
